verdict.rationale: The manual says Working Copy "supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab", which in context most likely refers to pull requests, though the excerpt never names the object. Hosted-platform integration, including private GitHub Enterprise and GitLab instances, is separately documented. missing for 10: an explicit statement that pull requests can be created, details of the PR workflow (title, description, base/target branch selection, reviewers), whether PR creation works on Enterprise/self-hosted instances, independent or hands-on corroboration.
